title: A Gentleman in Moscow (TV series)
premise_summary: A Gentleman in Moscow is a British historical drama series based on the 2016 novel by Amor Towles. Ben Vanstone is writer, executive producer, and showrunner. The series stars Ewan McGregor in the role of Count Alexander Rostov and premiered on Paramount+ on 29 March 2024.
